idea: 数据更新事件驱动：捕捉两数据源近期(<20天)发生更新且差异收敛（5日变化>-0.01，即趋于一致）且当前差异<5%的窗口，视为数据质量提升或财报披露事件；此时给予全额敞口，否则给予50%权重作为惩罚，结合集中度排名分位构建非线性响应信号。
expression_list: group_zscore(multiply(rank(winsorize(rsk74_raw_concentration,std=4)), trade_when(and(less(abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2)), 0.05), less(days_from_last_change(add(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2)), 20), greater(ts_delta(abs(subtract(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2)), 5), -0.01)), ts_mean(add(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2), 2), multiply(0.5, ts_mean(add(rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile1, rsk74_raw_exp_nondomicile2), 2)))), industry)
